prompt.project_info: Create a raw old-CCD-style bedroom snapshot with harsh flash, grain and an accidental over-shoulder glance, preserving the soft homewear and messy private-room atmosphere.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with dark hair in a loose messy updo and strands framing the face, natural skin texture and a surprised, shy caught-off-guard expression. She wears a loose cream knit cardigan over a pale camisole-style inner top, with safe non-explicit coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 candid mobile frame from a rear three-quarter angle. The adult woman is seated or turning near the bed, shoulders slightly raised and head turning toward camera as if just noticed the photograph. Include dim bedroom furniture, open doorway, shelves, clock and lived-in household details in the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct phone flash creates uneven highlights and deep shadows in a dim room, with visible grain, slight motion softness and authentic old-CCD color. Keep the moment accidental, quiet and homey without sexualized framing.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical smartphone/old-CCD snapshot, rear three-quarter angle, slight motion blur, grainy low-light texture, realistic skin and knit detail, imperfect framing and restrained saturation.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a raw old-CCD-style bedroom snapshot with harsh phone flash of one original approved adult woman with dark hair in a loose messy updo and strands framing the face, natural skin texture and a surprised, shy caught-off-guard expression. She wears a loose cream knit cardigan over a pale camisole-style inner top with safe non-explicit coverage. Use a vertical 9:16 candid mobile frame from a rear three-quarter angle; she is seated or turning near the bed with shoulders slightly raised and head turning toward camera as if just noticed the photograph. Include dim bedroom furniture, open doorway, shelves, wall clock and lived-in household details. Use direct flash, deep shadows, visible grain, slight motion softness, realistic knit texture and imperfect old-CCD color.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, fetish framing, child, teen, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, wardrobe malfunction, transparent clothing, invented logos, unreadable text
